svg.title: Agent environment

desc.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-dasharray: none; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400;

svg.desc: Thirteen blocks and twenty-eight connections. Agents 1 and 2 form the left column. Actors 1 and 2 form the next column, with their Inboxes between them. The Director is to their right. Resources 1 connects to Agent 1, Actor 1, and Director. Resources 2 connects to Agent 2, Actor 2, and Director. The four new Agent and Actor resource connections are dashed and have no arrowheads: their existence is confirmed, but their directions are not yet specified. The existing Director to Resources arrows are retained. Database, Recurring events, and Clock form the far-right column. Database points to Director. Director advances Clock and initializes Recurring events. Clock points to Recurring events, which trigger Director. On narrow screens, R1 and R2 mean Resources 1 and Resources 2. DB means Database, and Events means Recurring events.
